notes: CONTACT-BROKER RESULT ENCOUNTERED AND REFUSED. The first search returned a RocketReach page titled 'Bhavani Ganji Email & Phone Number | CARE Hospitals, Quality CARE India Limited Senior Consultant Neurosurgeon Contact Information'. RocketReach is a barred contact broker under rule 4, so I did not open it, did not use it, and have recorded NO email or phone for this doctor. Its URL is deliberately kept out of every field and out of `sources`. The only thing I took from seeing that title is that it independently echoes the job title 'Senior Consultant Neurosurgeon, CARE Hospitals' - and even that is corroborated properly by his own LinkedIn headline, which is what I cited. BRANCH MATCH REQUIRED AND MET: because the input row carried no experience figure, I required the CARE branch to match explicitly. It does - CARE's own domain returned a per-doctor page titled 'Dr. Bhavani Prasad Ganji | Neurosurgeon in Malakpet, Hyderabad | CARE Hospitals' at https://www.carehospitals.com/doctor/hyderabad/malakpet/bhavani-prasad-ganji-neurosurgeon , with city and the malakpet branch encoded in the URL path, and Practo independently lists him as 'Neurosurgeon in Malakpet, Hyderabad'. Name + specialty + hospital + branch + city all match. The input row's 'Epilepsy' sub-specialty also matches: his published expertise explicitly includes 'Epilepsy surgeries' and DBS for epilepsy. NOT an index-coverage gap and NOT a stale affiliation - CARE publishes a live per-doctor page for him at the exact branch given. BRANCH NUANCE WORTH A HUMAN GLANCE: he appears to work across two CARE units. CARE's per-doctor page and Practo place him at Malakpet (matching the input row), while a CARE 'Doctor Speak' page carries the hitec-city slug and one profile states 'Senior Consultant Neurosurgeon at CARE Hospital, HITEC City, Hyderabad (2024-Present)'. I recorded the Malakpet page as hospital_profile because that is the branch in the input row and the branch CARE's own doctor URL uses; the HITEC City association is noted rather than treated as a contradiction. LINKEDIN: recorded because the result title itself named him, his exact title and his employer - 'Dr Bhavani Prasad Ganji - Senior Consultant Neurosurgeon - CARE Hospitals, Quality CARE India Limited' - which is two independent identity factors in the URL's own title, so it is his personal profile and not a company page. Recorded verbatim including the sa. locale subdomain and the ?_l=en query string, per the instruction never to 'correct' a returned URL. OWNS_CLINIC SET TRUE, WITH A CAVEAT: the evidence is the published line 'He works at Bhavani Clinic in Kothapet, Hyderabad, with operating hours from 6:00 PM - 9:00 PM, seven days a week', which appeared consistently across the directory profiles, and the clinic is eponymous (his own first name) with a solo evening list - that reads as a personal private practice rather than employment. Flagging that as the one inference a human may want to confirm.
